command: ghdl --synth --std=08 top.vhd -e top
version: GHDL 6.0.0 (tarball) [Dunoon edition]
exit: 0
--- stderr
--- stdout
library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;
use ieee.math_real.all;
entity top is
  generic (
    DEPTH: positive := 100
  );
  port (
    clk: in std_ulogic;
    rst: in std_ulogic;
    q: out unsigned (integer (ceil (log2 (real (DEPTH)))) - 1 downto 0)
  );
end entity;

library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

architecture rtl of top is
  signal wrap_clk: std_logic;
  signal wrap_rst: std_logic;
  subtype typ_wrap_q is std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal wrap_q: typ_wrap_q;
  signal count : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal n4 : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal n6 : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal n9 : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
begin
  wrap_clk <= clk;
  wrap_rst <= rst;
  q <= unsigned(wrap_q);
  wrap_q <= count;
  -- top.vhd:20:10
  count <= n9; -- (signal)
  -- top.vhd:28:24
  n4 <= std_logic_vector (unsigned (count) + unsigned'("0000001"));
  -- top.vhd:25:7
  n6 <= n4 when wrap_rst = '0' else "0000000";
  -- top.vhd:24:5
  process (wrap_clk)
  begin
    if rising_edge (wrap_clk) then
      n9 <= n6;
    end if;
  end process;
end rtl;
